startup.scope: Visible Windows desktop sampling; startup disk cache is not flushed; not a cold boot benchmark. Four corner markers detect a presented frame. White duration is a sampled estimate, not a continuous trace; readback and DWM animation affect latency. Screen sampling overhead is identical for all variants.

startupAot.scope: Visible Windows desktop sampling; startup disk cache is not flushed; not a cold boot benchmark. Four corner markers detect a presented frame. White duration is a sampled estimate, not a continuous trace; readback and DWM animation affect latency. Screen sampling overhead is identical for all variants.

system.scope: CPU RenderTargetBitmap + real Fluent controls; no GPU or desktop presentation timing
system.fontAudit: Actual selected normal face glyf/cmap/head/hmtx/OS2 tables, checked after measurement.

fixed.Backend: CPU software; real Avalonia controls, layout/templates, RenderTargetBitmap + ImmediateRenderer; no window-present or GPU timing

tile.scenario: 160 updates of one 512x512 source / 320x240 ImageBrush tile; 8 warmup updates; CPU only
tile.fontSetup: automatic system discovery; no text or font face selection

desktop.windowPosition: offscreen on Windows; measures render/present service time, not visible monitor FPS
desktop.note: GPU timers include fence/event completion; capture disabled during timed frames. CPU glyph atlas construction and CPU layers are recorded, not called GPU rasterization.
